summary: Friday’s report leaves Townsend off the list and Terry questionable. Oklahoma will be without left tackle Michael Fasusi, with guard Eddy Pierre-Louis doubtful; watch how Texas attacks those protection assignments while keeping a quick answer ready on offense.

items.headline: Townsend is off the report; Terry remains questionable for Oklahoma
items.tldr: Friday’s SEC report keeps Lockett, Coleman and Zion Williams out. Follow Townsend’s actual workload and the final update on Terry before assigning him a role.

items.headline: Bishop’s four-receiver package gives Texas another offensive look
items.tldr: Texas introduced the package against UTSA to get Bishop on the field alongside its top three receivers. Watch the screen game and protection when the tight end comes off.

items.headline: Simmons set a Texas record with 5.5 sacks at Tennessee
items.tldr: The record describes the September 26 game, not a projection for Dallas. Watch whether the edge pressure can hurry Oklahoma’s quarterback while keeping an escape lane covered.

items.headline: Oklahoma lists Fasusi out and Pierre-Louis doubtful on Friday
items.tldr: Eli Bowen is also questionable. Watch how Oklahoma protects the left side of its line; Texas still needs connected pressure that accounts for the quarterback’s escape lane.

items.headline: Texas–Florida is set for 11 a.m. CT on October 17
items.tldr: The network remains ABC or ESPN, with the final choice due after October 10. Plan for the early start next week while this week’s focus stays on Oklahoma.

lead.headline: Keep a quick answer ready.
lead.body: Oklahoma’s left-side protection has changed availability to work around. Watch Texas close the pocket together; on offense, keep the screen or short route ready when Oklahoma sends pressure.

matchup.thesis: Test the protection without losing contain
matchup.question: What should Texas emphasize against Oklahoma?
matchup.answer: Watch the left side of Oklahoma’s protection with Fasusi out and Pierre-Louis doubtful. Keep the quarterback’s escape lane covered, then give the Texas offense a quick throw when pressure comes.
